title: Fideon canonical schema - surety (policy_check)
description: SPEC_21 section 4 canonical schema for surety (L1 code surety), composing common_model.json 1.1.0 by $ref: the envelope plus the bond block. Built from the single-LOB documents of the source-data sure folder (read in place): Western Surety Company's New York liquor license or permit bonds (Bond Form L-9) with their powers of attorney, all four scanned pages under an OCR text layer. Every field of the pre-SPEC_21 surety.json (surety.crosswalk.yaml). No LOB block.
fideon:status: SPEC_21 Phase 2 schema (12 October 2026), built from the sure folder's single-LOB bonds; replaces the pre-SPEC_21 surety.json. Draft for the project owner's approval. The four source documents are scans (L1 never reads them; they escalate), so no seed gold was drafted against it (CHANGE_REQUESTS_surety.md CR-SU-02).

corpora: synth_core/fideon/synth_core/data/source data/<Carrier>/sure/ (4 documents, all scanned; 0 seeds)

fideon:lob_block: None. The bond's number, type, penal sum, principal, obligee and term are the common model's bond block; the bond number is also the policy number, the principal the named insured, the surety the carrier and the penal sum the SU_ bond coverage's policy_limit (the core fields the mandatory list names). The bond form, the prescribing authority, the principal's trade name and county, the application number and the attorney-in-fact are additional_fields (SPEC_21 4.2.4).
fideon:audit_rules_note: A bond prints a penal sum and a term, not a policy period: the common model's policy-period rules are replaced by the bond's own; the claims-made rule does not apply. A rule whose values a document does not print is not evaluated.
